correctness.rationale: Reconstructed sign-case factor: two possible first-column row orderings times one-half reinforcing signs; on reinforcing outcome Schur magnitude D+(c/a)B, so 1<t<2 event is exactly the fourfold half-density integral. For Gaussian, polar (B,D) and c=qa yield exact angular integral 4/pi^2 * h^2/[t^2+(1+q^2)h^2]. At epsilon=2-t, the two max(B,D) cones each have scaled triangle area 1/2; the max-a region has three thin variables O(epsilon^3); exp envelope permits limit. Independent midpoint integration at t=1.5,1.9 gave 0.021940014849, 0.000560707810; exact Laplace K integral =1/32. Gaussian coefficient 1/(2pi^2) follows by gamma integral. The checked endpoints do not prove density-universal asymptotics.
